data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Add phase-advance helper dependency. The audit READER (audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh) requires the WRITER discipline: who writes .reconciler-phase-gate and appends .reconciler-phase-gate.ops? Add prerequisite: a phase-advance helper script audit_phase_advance.sh that (a) atomically updates .reconciler-phase-gate plain-text file via atomic rename (write to .tmp, then mv), (b) appends one valid JSON Lines record to .reconciler-phase-gate.ops {operator, timestamp, phase, comment}. Runbook documents the exact phase-advance command operators must run. Add RED test: documented command leaves both files in valid state (plain-text matches new phase + ops file has one new well-formed JSON Lines record). Without writer discipline, DD-4 reader enforcement breaks (cross_task_interference).
